name: tpk
description: TesterPayKit Claude Code plugin. Skills are namespaced /tpk:* (tpk:connect, tpk:bootstrap, tpk:integrate, tpk:status, tpk:cli-install, tpk:fix-next-bug) so they're easy to find among other skills. They wrap the `tpk` CLI (pub.dev: tpk_cli) to bootstrap projects with payout rules, integrate the SDK into Flutter (with moinsen_runapp), Expo/React-Native, Web/TypeScript, or native Swift (iOS/macOS, early access) apps, query status, and CLOSE THE AGENTIC FEEDBACK LOOP via /tpk:fix-next-bug. /tpk:live connects Claude to the developer's own running app (screenshot, screen texts, notes, tap/type/scroll) and keeps a tester checklist. Also registers the remote `testerpaykit` MCP server (api.testerpaykit.com/mcp): order tests with real human testers, read their sessions, verdicts and bugs — set TPK_API_TOKEN from the console first (/tpk:connect). New here? /tpk:guide is an interactive course through the whole system with saved progress. Real testers report, Claude fixes, you ship.
